fields.description: Design Quarter at d3 is a three-building residential collection in Dubai Design District. One low-rise building and two taller towers contain 558 one- to three-bedroom apartments. The reviewed Tower B documents also include split-level three-bedroom homes with large terraces.

overview: Tower B’s Type 06 duplex places living areas and one bedroom on the lower level, with two further bedrooms above. Its total includes balconies and terraces; furniture and view illustrations do not establish contract specifications.
research.locationNote: Dubai Design District, Dubai. The development is residential; nearby creative offices, retail and canal-side routes are neighbourhood context rather than guaranteed private facilities for every home.
research.priceNote: The sold-out Meraas page retains an AED 1.87m project guide. The original Tower B sheet instead starts at 2.02m for one bedroom, 3.05m for two and 6.61m for three. These refer to different releases; no current minimum or live developer stock is confirmed.
research.paymentNote: The official Tower B calendar gives 20% booking; 10% October 2023; 10% April 2024; 10% October 2024; 10% April 2025; 40% May 2027 handover. Property Finder instead shows 10/50/40 and a different FAQ split. The original dated primary plan is displayed, not a hybrid or current signed offer.
research.handoverNote: The Tower B sheet estimatesMay 2027, while Dubai Holding’sMarch 2025 announcement targetsmid 2027. Property Finder instead reportsFebruary 2027. The precise current contractual date remains unresolved and the overall headline is withheld.
